reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Oklahoma
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Basic domain modeling helpers
% -----------------------------

% We treat "eviction" (because of a protected characteristic) as "otherwise make unavailable or deny any housing"
% within 25 OK Stat  25-1452(A)(1) (2021).

% -----------------------------
% Statute encoding (Oklahoma)
% -----------------------------

/*
  25 OK Stat  25-1452 (2021)

  Key parts encoded:
  -  25-1452(A)(1): unlawful discriminatory housing practice to "otherwise make unavailable or deny any housing"
    because of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, familial status, or disability.
  -  25-1452(A)(2): unlawful to discriminate in terms/conditions/privileges of rental because of those same bases.
  -  25-1452(C): No other categories/classes protected under  1451-1453.
*/

% protected_basis/1 is intentionally closed to ONLY the categories listed in the statute.
% (25 OK Stat  25-1452(A)(1)-(2) and  25-1452(C) (2021))
protected_basis(race).
protected_basis(color).
protected_basis(religion).
protected_basis(gender).
protected_basis(national_origin).
protected_basis(age).
protected_basis(familial_status).
protected_basis(disability).

% act_type/1 is a controlled vocabulary for the kinds of conduct we reason about.
act_type(refuse_to_rent).
act_type(refuse_to_sell).
act_type(refuse_to_negotiate).
act_type(make_unavailable_or_deny).
act_type(discriminate_terms_conditions_privileges).

% eviction_is_denial/1 links eviction to "make unavailable or deny" for purposes of  25-1452(A)(1).
% This is a legal characterization used for the reasoning layer.
eviction_is_denial(make_unavailable_or_deny).

% statute_25_1452_a1_unlawful/3
% (25 OK Stat  25-1452(A)(1) (2021))
% Unlawful if a person/agent makes housing unavailable or denies housing because of a protected basis.
statute_25_1452_a1_unlawful(Actor, make_unavailable_or_deny, Basis) :-
    nonvar(Actor),
    protected_basis(Basis).

% statute_25_1452_a2_unlawful/3
% (25 OK Stat  25-1452(A)(2) (2021))
% Unlawful if a person/agent discriminates in terms/conditions/privileges of rental because of a protected basis.
statute_25_1452_a2_unlawful(Actor, discriminate_terms_conditions_privileges, Basis) :-
    nonvar(Actor),
    protected_basis(Basis).

% statute_25_1452_closed_list/1
% (25 OK Stat  25-1452(C) (2021))
% Encodes that only the listed bases are protected. If something is not in protected_basis/1, it is not protected here.
statute_25_1452_closed_list(Basis) :-
    protected_basis(Basis).

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (the question)
% -----------------------------

% The question is asked in Oklahoma, focus year 2021.
scenario_state(oklahoma).
scenario_year(2021).

% Parties and housing
person(landlord1).
person(tenant1).
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).
housing(dwelling1).

% Tenant occupies the dwelling (tenancy exists).
tenancy(tenant1, dwelling1).

% Conduct: landlord evicts the tenant.
% We encode an eviction as an event and then map it to the statutory act type.
eviction_event(evict1, landlord1, tenant1, dwelling1).

% Motivation asserted by the question: the eviction is because of the tenant's gender identity.
motive(evict1, gender_identity).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds exactly when the factual statement is present:
% "An Oklahoma landlord evicts a tenant because of the tenant's gender identity" (in 2021).
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(oklahoma),
    scenario_year(2021),
    landlord(landlord1),
    tenant(tenant1),
    housing(dwelling1),
    tenancy(tenant1, dwelling1),
    eviction_event(evict1, landlord1, tenant1, dwelling1),
    motive(evict1, gender_identity).

% -----------------------------
% Reasoning layer: apply statute to scenario
% -----------------------------

% event_act_type/2 maps scenario events into statutory act types.
event_act_type(EventId, ActType) :-
    eviction_event(EventId, _Landlord, _Tenant, _Dwelling),
    eviction_is_denial(ActType).

% unlawful_discriminatory_housing_practice/1 holds if the scenario event satisfies a statutory prohibition.
unlawful_discriminatory_housing_practice(EventId) :-
    eviction_event(EventId, Actor, _Tenant, _Dwelling),
    event_act_type(EventId, ActType),
    motive(EventId, Basis),
    statute_25_1452_closed_list(Basis),              % enforces  25-1452(C) closed list
    (   statute_25_1452_a1_unlawful(Actor, ActType, Basis)
    ;   statute_25_1452_a2_unlawful(Actor, ActType, Basis)
    ).

% -----------------------------
% Final answer predicate
% -----------------------------

% housing_answer/1 must be deterministic and return yes/no.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    unlawful_discriminatory_housing_practice(evict1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ unlawful_discriminatory_housing_practice(evict1),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
